articles.title: Hardware wallet sales in Russia more than double as new crypto rules near
articles.snippet: Wildberries’ average price for hardware wallets fell 13% to 7,900 rubles, and M.Video broadened its range of products, though neither retailer identified the driving force behind the renewed demand.

articles.title: OKX's Rafique doubts Clarity Act will pass, warns optimism is already priced into bitcoin
articles.snippet: The OKX executive says Democrats have little incentive to hand Republicans a crypto victory before the midterms.

articles.title: How a five-second trick let traders drain millions from Polymarket
articles.snippet: After months of public warnings from onchain analysts, the prediction market is moving to time-weighted prices to make artificial price pushes too costly.

articles.title: CLARITY Act delay gives Asian financial hubs an opening: First Digital CEO
articles.snippet: Industry figures warned that continued legislative limbo could slow institutional adoption, revive regulation by enforcement and push innovation offshore.

articles.title: Flock Wanted to Turn 350,000 Uber Drivers Into a Nationwide Plate-Scanning Fleet
articles.snippet: A leaked Flock presentation shows the surveillance firm pitching a plan to pull license-plate data from rideshare and delivery drivers.
